requirements.invariant: Rollback/restore initiation always reevaluates current security, data/schema compatibility, provider and release eligibility; historical eligibility never authorizes current recovery.
Roll-forward is a first-class content-bound recovery plan with exact scope, authority, evidence, target and migration identity; undocumented hotfix recovery is not representable.
Schema/state-contract recovery is allowed only with explicit current backward/forward compatibility and migration obligations; UNKNOWN or INCOMPATIBLE blocks consequential recovery.
Current prohibited/revoked security, key, credential, policy, provider or release standing dominates historical state; recovery can never resurrect a currently prohibited subject.
